name: zforge
description: Durable state, contract and evidence layer for multi-session feature work: contract-bounded planning, autonomous phase orchestration with evidence-based acceptance, and ledger-versus-implementation review.

interface.shortDescription: Contract-bounded planning, evidence-based acceptance, and phase orchestration.
interface.longDescription: zforge carries what must be true before a phase closes, what evidence proves it, what was decided along the way, and what is still open across multi-session feature work.
defaultPrompt: Use zforge to plan this feature.
Use zforge to review this implementation.
Use zforge to resume this feature plan.
